subject: zoology
question_text: What is camouflage? Give its significance.

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.61, VSAQ 160). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Definition
lines: Camouflage is the phenomenon in which the
colour of an animal matches the colour of
Some animals change colour to match the
Ex: chameleon, leaf insect, stick insect.
steps.why: Camouflage covers two different cases — a colour that changes and a colour that is fixed from birth — and naming both stops the answer from being read as being only about the chameleon.
common_mistakes: Writing that every camouflaged animal changes colour. The leaf insect is coloured that way from birth.
Giving no example. The named animals are part of the definition mark.
steps.memory_tip: Two kinds: the chameleon changes its colour, the leaf insect was born with it.
steps.margin_note: One sentence, one line for the two kinds, then the examples.

steps.label: Significance
lines: An animal whose colour matches its
background is hard for a predator to see.
This lowers its chance of being eaten.
A predator may also use camouflage to come
steps.why: The significance is a survival value and must be stated in terms of being seen, because that is the physical fact the colour changes — not the animal's behaviour.
common_mistakes: Writing that the animal becomes invisible. It becomes HARD TO SEE, not invisible.
Giving only the prey side. A predator may use camouflage too.
steps.memory_tip: Matching the background works both ways: prey are not seen, and predators are not seen either.
steps.margin_note: Two short lines on the prey, one on the predator. Do not repeat the examples here.

insider_note: The significance is the second mark and needs the words predator or prey in it — a student who only repeats the definition scores one.
